newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bahrain jails three men for arson attacks-lawyer.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain jails three men for arson attacks-lawyer.

text.p: Bahrain's state security court has sentenced three nationals to three years in jail for arson attacks, a lawyer said on Monday.
The same court also sentenced to three months in jail a fourth man for distributing anti-government leaflets, he added.

"The court ruled on Sunday to sentence the three for arson attacks on some power stations and shops," the lawyer said by telephone from Manama. Police arrested the men after the attacks took place last year.
The court's sentences cannot be appealed.

The court has sentenced more than 150 people since Bahrain's government -- seeking to accelerate judgements -- ordered it in March to try hundreds of detainees held for street protests, sabotage and arson attacks since political unrest erupted in the Gulf Arab island in December 1994.
Members of Bahrain's majority Shi'ite community have been waging a violent campaign to demand political and economic reforms. More than 27 people have died in waves of violence.
